A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''Shamed One''' was a part of the [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'' heresy]], and preached to members of the sect in abandoned places. Before becoming a [[Shamed Ones|Shamed One]], he had been a member of the [[Intendant caste]] before his [[Limb/Legends|arm]] implant went bad. A disguised [[Nom Anor]] attended the Shamed Ones's preachings a few times.
